description: This Java class defines a command for retrieving policy entries based on a Policy ID within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and overrides for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyEntries
classes.description: A final class representing a command to retrieve policy entries by PolicyId, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, with associated metadata and behavior.

methods.name: of

methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, with optional headers.

methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the PolicyId payload to a JsonObjectBuilder considering the schema version and predicate.

methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.description: Checks equality based on PolicyId and superclass properties.
